The '''21st [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1963, were held on March 11, 1964.

==Winners and nominees==
[[File:Sidney Poitier 1968.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Sidney Poitier]] won for ''[[Lilies of the Field (1963 film)|Lilies of the Field]]'']]
[[File:Leslie Caron-publicity.JPG|thumb|right|160px|[[Leslie Caron]] won for ''[[The L-Shaped Room]]'']]
[[File:Shirley MacLaine - 1960.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Shirley MacLaine]] won for ''[[Irma la Douce]]'']]
[[File:Dame Margaret Rutherford 1960 publicity photo.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Dame Margaret Rutherford]] won for ''[[The V.I.P.s (film)|The V.I.P.s]]'']]
